caseName: Swan Carburetor Co. v. Nash Motor Co.
caseNameFull: Swan Carburetor Co. v. Nash Motor Co.
attorneys: Messrs. F. 0. Richey, B. D. Watts, and Edwin F. Samuels for petitioner. Mr. William J. Barnes for respondent.
